verdict.rationale: Evidence shows QuickBooks Online offers reporting and forecasting capabilities (AI-driven report generation, 13-week P&L/cash-flow forecasting) but never explicitly confirms on-demand generation of a standard P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period, and one community report claims QBO lacks many reports present in the desktop version. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of balance sheet and cash-flow statement generation (not just forecasting), independent hands-on confirmation of report accuracy, and rebuttal to the desktop-parity complaint.
